question: With the same work, power, shared capacity and deadlines, and only forecasts available at decision time, how much carbon exposure does delaying flexible electricity use avoid?
scope: Stage 1 only: flexible batch jobs. No battery, no car park, no product changes.

workload.arrival: uniform over half-hours 08:00-19:30 UTC, every day
workload.duration_slots: uniform integer 2..8 (1-4 h), contiguous, not interruptible
workload.deadline: arrival + duration + flexibility; 0 h means run as soon as capacity allows
workload.identical_jobs: The same job list (arrival, duration, power) is used for every policy and every flexibility level

decision_rule: At a job's arrival the scheduler commits a start time: the feasible start (capacity respected, deadline met) with the lowest forecast carbon over the job's run. Observations strictly before the arrival slot only. No re-planning. Infeasible jobs are counted as missed, never dropped.

policies.fixed_time_of_day: Mean carbon by half-hour of day from the training window; no live data
policies.seasonal_median: Median of the same half-hour on the previous 7 days, using only lags already observed
policies.persistence_blend: Seasonal median plus the latest observed anomaly decaying with horizon, exp(-h/tau); tau selected on validation
policies.lightgbm_multi_horizon: New direct multi-horizon LightGBM (issue time, horizon, calendar, recent levels, available daily lags); fitted on training, configuration chosen on validation
policies.perfect_foresight: Same online scheduler with actual carbon as the forecast: keeps durations, power, capacity and competition between jobs; a constrained reference, not a global optimum
policies.neso_published_reference: NESO's published forecast field; issuance time not archived, likely short lead time. Reference only, not a valid decision baseline

splits.validation: 2025-05-01 to 2025-06-30 (tau, LightGBM configuration; selection metric: carbon at 24 h flexibility)
splits.exploratory_test: 2025-07-01 to 2025-12-31 (months already examined in earlier GridProof work; exploratory only)
splits.independent_test: 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-16 NESO actual carbon intensity, downloaded after this design and never used for any choice

metrics: kg CO2 exposure (location-based, average GB intensity) and % versus immediate
share of the perfect-foresight reduction captured
7-day block bootstrap 95% intervals by arrival day
breakdown by job duration and arrival time
interpretation: 10% at 24 h or less is the target worth deepening, not a pass mark. 5-10% is judged with controllable energy, cost, deadlines and simple rivals. Average intensity measures exposure, not causal marginal abatement.
